top_signals.title: Gold Falls Ahead of US Inflation Print That Could Shift Fed Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold edged lower for a third day as traders waited for a US inflation print that could provide a clue to the Federal Reserve’s next move on interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Houthis strike Saudi Aramco headquarters
top_signals.summary: Iran-backed militants retaliate after Riyadh-led coalition targets sites in Yemen’s capital
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China's producer prices rise at fastest pace since June 2022, beating expectations
top_signals.summary: The increase was higher than the 4.5% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and higher than the 3.8% seen in the previous month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
top_signals.summary: DRW and Marex completed the first OTC swap referencing a fully tokenized index on Derivnex via the Canton Network, with Kaiko data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
